name: Product Discovery (SDLC Phase 1)
description: Understanding user needs and defining product requirements — aka Discovery Sprint, Exploration Sprint, Problem/Solution Fit, Inception, Validation Sprint.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Product Discovery
capabilities.description: Establishes a validated understanding of user needs, problems, and product requirements through structured research and hypothesis testing.

services.name: Product Requirements Document
services.contractDescription: Comprehensive product requirements document specifying user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature scopes.

services.name: User Personas
services.contractDescription: Target user profiles, behavioral archetypes, and key characteristics.

services.name: Customer Journey Map
services.contractDescription: End-to-end user experience mapping across key touchpoints and pain moments.

services.name: Jobs-to-be-Done Statements
services.contractDescription: Detailed JTBD analysis specifying functional, social, and emotional user jobs.

services.name: Research Plan & Interview Guide
services.contractDescription: User research methodology, target cohort sampling, and structured interview protocol.

services.name: Research Findings Report
services.contractDescription: User research results, affinity maps, key insights, and evidence metrics.

services.name: Service Blueprint
services.contractDescription: Service design mapping frontstage actions, backstage processes, and support systems.

services.name: Hypothesis Validation Tracker
services.contractDescription: Assumption testing framework tracking validated, invalidated, and pending hypotheses.

checklists.name: Product Discovery (SDLC Phase 1) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for user research, requirements definition, and hypothesis testing.

items.statement: The persona, journey, and JTBD artifacts are grounded in actual user research rather than internal assumption.
At least 5 qualitative user interviews or quantitative research responses have been conducted and documented.
Product Requirements Document includes clear functional specifications, non-functional targets, and measurable acceptance criteria.
All core product hypotheses have been logged in the validation tracker with explicit pass/fail criteria.
Service blueprint maps key customer touchpoints to backend support systems and operational dependencies.

reviewGates.name: Product Requirements Review
reviewGates.statement: The Product Requirements Document has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Experience Design.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Product Requirements Document reflect validated user/market research and provide sufficient direction for Experience Design?
